echoParts: I am the way and the truth and the life.
No one comes to the Father
verseText: Jesus said to him, 'I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'
meaning: The only way we can be part of the forever kingdom of God the Father is through Jesus. Because he died and rose again, we can have eternal life.
